local_patch: Mandatory classification of final compiled repeated-extglob bodies; bounded finite unambiguous grammar, independently certified greedy nullable-character-star rewrites, and literalization of unsupported repetition. Raw group repetitions are checked as well so they cannot wrap a finite accepted extglob in another unsafe repeat. Token accounting fixes ensure emitted and checked bodies agree.
security_boundary: Local repeated-extglob compilation only. Not a general safety guarantee for arbitrary caller-supplied regular expressions or forged parse states.
compatibility_policy: Keep existing major APIs. Preserve reviewed ordinary globs, safe finite repeats, literal stars, and all branches of certified star rewrites. Unsupported ambiguous or complex repeated forms intentionally become literals; recursion opt-outs cannot disable this guard.
